SELECT "customer"."store_id" AS e, AVG(("customer"."store_id" - "customer"."address_id")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2, (AVG(("customer"."store_id" - "customer"."address_id")) - COUNT(*)) AS m3 FROM "customer" GROUP BY "customer"."store_id" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "rental"."staff_id" AS g, SUM("payment"."customer_id") AS m1, AVG("payment"."payment_id") AS m2 FROM "payment" JOIN "rental" ON "rental"."rental_id" = "payment"."rental_id" GROUP BY "rental"."staff_id") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s1"."m2") AS m2, (CAST(SUM("s1"."m1") AS REAL) / SUM("s1"."m2")) AS m3 FROM "s1"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "inventory"."film_id" AS e, "film"."rating" AS g, SUM("inventory"."store_id") AS m1, SUM(("inventory"."inventory_id" - "inventory"."film_id")) AS m2, (SUM("inventory"."store_id") - SUM(("inventory"."inventory_id" - "inventory"."film_id"))) AS m3 FROM "inventory" JOIN "film" ON "film"."film_id" = "inventory"."film_id"  GROUP BY "inventory"."film_id", "film"."rating") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "customer"."store_id" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "customer" GROUP BY "customer"."store_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
